title: Magic And More
description: Discover magical items, powerful spells, and so much more.
body:
Discover a world full of magical artifacts, spells, and mystical items in Magic and More! This beta release adds a variety of unique magical tools, enchanted equipment, and gameplay-enhancing mechanics for adventurous players.


Features:


Magical Artifacts:

Collect powerful items like the Amulet of Souls, Cursed Heart, Frost Crown, and Orb of Shadows.

Each artifact has unique abilities that affect gameplay and exploration.


Crystals & Mana System:

Gather Mana Crystals and interact with Mana Blocks to cast spells or enhance equipment.

Upgrade your magical abilities using the Mana Upgrader and Starter Mana Upgrader.


Spells & Magic Items:

Wield magical wands, rings, and enchanted objects like the Ring of Storms or Phoenix Feather.

Customize your spell loadout and experience new ways to interact with the world.


Crafting & Recipes:

Use intuitive crafting recipes for artifacts, crystals, and other magical items.

Smelt Mana Ore and combine materials to create powerful items and equipment.

Interactive Mechanics:

Certain artifacts provide abilities that change depending on context, like combat or exploration.


Beta Notice:

This is a beta release; features may change in future updates.

**Requires** **Curios API** (**Required**).

**Vivecraft** support is **optional** for VR players.

This mod is perfect for players who want to explore magical worlds, collect rare artifacts, cast spells, and enhance their Minecraft experience with mystical gameplay mechanics.
